edges.reason: Constructor of Owned assigns owner from the untrusted msg.sender, granting all onlyOwner privileges.
onlyOwner modifier gates transferOwnership on msg.sender == owner.
onlyOwner modifier gates transfernewun on msg.sender == owner.
onlyOwner modifier gates clearCNDAO on msg.sender == owner.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender to equal the pending newOwner.
transfer debits and credits balances keyed by the caller's msg.sender.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender].
transferFrom spends allowed[from][msg.sender].
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] and forwards msg.sender to the callee.
clearCNDAO stores msg.sender into local _owner before transferring the balance.
The local _owner is the recipient of the full contract balance transfer.
clearCNDAO executes the balance-draining transfer operation.
approveAndCall invokes receiveApproval on an attacker-controlled spender after updating allowance.
The callee contract can call back into approveAndCall during the external call.
The arbitrary callee can re-enter transfer while approveAndCall is executing.
spender parameter is used directly as the target of the external call.
tokens parameter is forwarded to the external receiveApproval call.
data parameter is forwarded to the external receiveApproval call.
transferOwnership writes the pending newOwner used by the ownership handover.
acceptOwnership writes owner, finalizing privileged control.
acceptOwnership clears newOwner to address(0).
owner-only transfernewun writes the newun address that restricts transfers.
TokenBEP20 constructor credits balances[owner].
TokenBEP20 constructor sets _totalSupply.
TokenBEP20 constructor mints the whole supply into balances.
totalSupply performs a SafeMath sub between _totalSupply and balances[address(0)].
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
transfer uses SafeMath sub/add on the balances mapping.
transfer requires to != newun, enforcing the owner-controlled restriction list.
approve writes the allowed mapping.
transferFrom uses SafeMath sub/add on balances.
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender].
transferFrom silently sets newun = to on the first call when newun == address(0); otherwise it reverts on to == newun, a hidden transfer restriction.
approveAndCall sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] before the external call.
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
Parameter _newOwner flows into transferOwnership.
Parameter _newun flows into transfernewun.
Parameter to flows into transfer as the credit destination.
Parameter tokens flows into transfer as the debit amount.
Parameter spender flows into approve as the allowance key.
Parameter from flows into transferFrom as the debit account.
Parameter to flows into transferFrom as the credit destination.
Parameter tokens flows into transferFrom as the amount.
Parameter spender flows into approveAndCall as allowance key and call target.
Parameter tokens flows into approveAndCall as the allowance amount.
Parameter data flows into approveAndCall and onward to the callee.
Parameter tokenOwner flows into balanceOf as the lookup key.
